notes.title: TEXT YOUR LIFE - VERSION 1.2.3 - NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Version 1.2.3 of Text Your Life is finally available!

In this version, you can now:

*Play the new content: Chapter 2 - Day 3. Chapter 2 is now complete!

*See a percentage inside each bar of the Affinity Tracker (in the Stats screen) next to the name of every character. This way, it will be easier to see the effect of your choices on your relationship with all of them! 🫂

*Delete saves! A new button will appear right next to every save/load slot 🗑️ We hope this helps you keep the Save and Load screens much more organized!

*Change the speed at which the chat messages appear! 💃 Just head to the Settings screens, and adjust the “Chat messages speed” bar to your liking!

Have fun!!

notes.title: Content update notes - Version 1.2.2
notes.notes:
Hey hey hey!! 

IT'S TIME FOR THE CONTENT UPDATE! 🥳💃 Version 1.2.2 of TYL is finally available!

Are you excited?!! Because we surely are!! Hehehehe 😆 GO PLAAAY! We recommend starting from the beggining instead of loading one of the old saves, because the game might not work properly if you do so. But it’s up to you!

Here are a few details of the content that was added to the new version of the game:

🆕 UPDATE CONTENT - APRIL 12th, 2025 🆕

This update includes all of day 5 (November 15th in-game), which is the second day of Chapter 2.  To sum it up:

✍️ Total words added: 18.500

🤔 Total options added: 157

⏳ Total playing time added, per playthrough: 1 hour and 40 minutes.  We encourage you to play several times so you don’t miss anything!

Also includes:

🔥 An… interesting conversation with Daniel.

😜 An epic battle with Samuel.

🤭 An artistic moment with Suho.

😱 An unexpected discovery about that fateful night.

🙈 A new addition to the cast that will bring even more… drama to the story.

All that, and much more! And, of course, a lot of fun and chaotic situations! 😜

We hope you like it as much as we do! We'll update you on our progress at the end of April, as always 🤗

Have fun!

notes.title: CONTENT UPDATE - DATE ANNOUNCEMENT! 🥳
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 🤗  How are you all doing? We are reaaaally happy right now because, after a few weeks of haaaard work, we can finally give you the date we’ll update the game with Chapter 2’s day 2 content! 🥳🎉💃 Remember: this update will only include the second day of Chapter 2 (day 5 in-game).
So, without further ado… let’s get to it! 😏:  on April 12th, everyone will get access to the update here on Steam!.

But… what will this content update include?:

📜 About 18.500 words added. This update is even lengthier than the last one!
🤔 157 choices added. So many options to choose from!
⏳ 1 hour and 40 minutes of playing time added, per playthrough. We encourage you to play several times so you don’t miss anything!
🔥 An… interesting conversation with Daniel.
😜 An epic battle with Samuel.
🤭 An artistic moment with Suho.
😱 An unexpected discovery about that fateful night.
🙈 A new addition to the cast that will bring even more… drama to the story.

All that, and much more! And, of course, a lot of fun and chaotic situations! 😜

We hope you like the new content as much as we do! 😚 The update is getting close, guys! Mark the day on your calendars! 🥳👏  Hehe.

Alma and Vera <3
